name: timestream-influxdb
description: Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB is a managed time-series database engine that makes it easy for application developers and DevOps teams to run InfluxDB databases…

subcommands.name: create-db-instance
subcommands.description: Creates a new Timestream for InfluxDB DB instance

options.name: --name
options.description: The name that uniquely identifies the DB instance when interacting with the Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB API and CLI commands.

options.name: --username
options.description: The username of the initial admin user created in InfluxDB. Must start with a letter and can't end with a hyphen or contain two consecutive hyphens.

options.name: --password
options.description: The password of the initial admin user created in InfluxDB.

options.name: --organization
options.description: The name of the initial organization for the initial admin user in InfluxDB. An InfluxDB organization is a workspace for a group of users

options.name: --bucket
options.description: The name of the initial InfluxDB bucket. All InfluxDB data is stored in a bucket.

options.name: --db-instance-type
options.description: The Timestream for InfluxDB DB instance type to run InfluxDB on

options.name: --vpc-subnet-ids
options.description: A list of VPC subnet IDs to associate with the DB instance.

options.name: --vpc-security-group-ids
options.description: A list of VPC security group IDs to associate with the DB instance

options.name: --publicly-accessible
options.description: Configures the DB instance with a public IP to facilitate access

options.name: --no-publicly-accessible
options.description: Configures the DB instance with a public IP to facilitate access

options.name: --db-storage-type
options.description: The Timestream for InfluxDB DB storage type to read and write InfluxDB data.

options.name: --allocated-storage
options.description: The amount of storage to allocate for your DB storage type in GiB (gibibytes)

options.name: --db-parameter-group-identifier
options.description: The id of the DB parameter group to assign to your DB instance. DB parameter groups specify how the database is configured.

options.name: --deployment-type
options.description: Specifies whether the DB instance will be deployed as a standalone instance or with a Multi-AZ standby for high availability

options.name: --log-delivery-configuration
options.description: Configuration for sending InfluxDB engine logs to a specified S3 bucket

options.name: --tags
options.description: A list of key-value pairs to associate with the DB instance

options.name: --port
options.description: The port number on which InfluxDB accepts connections.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided. The JSON string follows the format provided by ``--generate-cli-skeleton``.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.
